cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2 (ether type); prominent buffers Cocamidopropyl Betaine #3 and Coco-Glucoside #7; no reinforcing anionic -> moderate. PEG-4 Rapeseedamide #6 is an alkanolamide-type thickener/foam booster (C3 not a route, not a buffer). Counter-signals toward lower: Glycerin #5, Glyceryl Oleate #8.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Anchors (Section 5): several light routes give bounded care: Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #12 (after Parfum, not prominent), weak refatter Glyceryl Oleate #8, pearlizing PEG-3 Distearate #10, humectants Glycerin #5 / Panthenol #14, trace lipids Sclerocarya Birrea Seed Oil #20, Hydrogenated Coconut Oil #21, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate #26. C2 not met: no early silicone and no prominent payload_lipid. Counter-signal toward low: the only cationic is post-fragrance and all lipids are trace.

depositionLoad.rationale: One cationic polymer after the fragrance marker; lipids after preservatives (#20-#21, trace); weak refatters only.

persistence.rationale: No silicone, no prominent waxy lipid; guar at post-fragrance level is weakly retained in an SLES chassis.

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 ether-sulfate chassis with two prominent buffers.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Deposition is light and low-persistence; effective ordinary reset; nothing supports a noticeable loss of movement.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2 (several families present): the cationic guar #12 is after Parfum, both payload lipids #20/#21 are trace (after Sodium Benzoate #13 and Potassium Sorbate #16), and the remaining routes are weak_refatters plus humectants; their combined residue stays below noticeable against a moderate C1 reset. Not closely balanced (W3 not triggered).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Exact guar level unknown; a higher-charge-density guar could move to moderate.
weightPotential.rationale: 6.6 subjudgments light/low/moderate -> low. W1 not applicable (no silicone). Claims hidden during judgment.

careDirection.limitation: No damage-care/substantive cluster (no protein, silicone or prominent lipid); humectants are one prominent glycerin plus post-fragrance panthenol with only post-fragrance/trace conditioning support - generic conditioning that distinguishes neither direction.
